title: QA-Board metrics file (qa/metrics.yaml)
description: Describes the metrics your runs return, and which ones the web app shows. Listed in qaboard.yaml under outputs.metrics. Docs: https://samsung.github.io/qaboard/docs/computing-quantitative-metrics

available_metrics.description: The metrics, by the key `run()` returns them with.

^\\..description: Hidden: not a metric, e.g. to define YAML anchors.

default_metric.description: The metric selected by default: to sort runs, in lists of commits and their plot over time.

main_metrics.description: Shown in the results tables and on the run cards. Metrics don't need to be declared. Default: the tables show the declared metrics and others up to 20 columns, the run cards the first 6.

summary_metrics.description: Shown in the Summary. Default: those that changed the most vs the reference.

dashboard_metrics.description: Shown in the History page's summary and tables. Default: main_metrics, else the Summary picks.

dashboard_evolution_metrics.description: Available in the History page's plot over time. Default: main_metrics, else all the metrics of its commits.

dashboard_breakdown_by_tag.description: On the History page, summarize the metrics per tag of the inputs (their metadata's `tags`).

short_label.description: For tables and small spaces. Default: label.

smaller_is_better.description: Whether smaller values are better. null: neither, the web app shows changes in neutral colors. Left out: true in metrics files, unknown (like null) in metrics_definitions.json and in code.

target.description: The value to reach. Results are colored by how they compare to it.

target_passfail.description: The target is pass/fail: show results as passed or failed.

scale.description: Values are multiplied by it when shown, e.g. 100 for a percentage. Default: 1.

suffix.description: Shown after the values, e.g. `%` or ` ms`.

plot_scale.description: The scale of the axis in plots. Default: log in the Summary's box plots, linear on the History page.
